requirements: Prespecify block length before inference; block length must not be optimized against the realized inference statistic.
Preserve local serial dependence in the resampled loss process rather than assuming independent target losses.
For the nested finite-sample procedure, integrate the moving-block resampling with the residual-based component required by the selected nested-bootstrap specification.
Record the realized block-length rule and bootstrap configuration in the future inference receipt.

references: Grant, Mrazik, Satchell (2026), Journal of Forecasting, DOI 10.1002/for.70150
